name: Nova
source:
Nova is one of three protagonist gender choices the player can choose from. She is a student who is new to Aether West Academy.

It is her job to "steal the hearts" of all of her new friends!

[spoiler]Nova's real name is actually "Vanilla," and she's a type of "emotional vampire" called a Pathospire. Pathospires esentially absorb the emotional energy released from a broken heart. Nova was going to "feed on" her new friends by breaking their hearts at the dance.[/spoiler]
